reviews.review_description:
One star for overall impression, an extra star for the benefit of the doubt in case I dont know what Im doing.  Which leads back to any lack of direction when using this app.  You install into your headset but you immediately have to create a login and it opens up your browser to supposedly start 'creating'  I created an account which has you verify with email, then the app also opens up on your phone.   Using it on your phone is..well useless because you have to expand full-screen to see any sort of detail but then when you flip your phone to the side..full-screen closes and goes back to portrait.  

I generated a character with AI.  I described a greying guy in work coveralls with light brown skin.  It gave me a black guy with black hair in a power rangers outfit.  

In the browser on the headset, it prompted me to enter a name for the character, but my virtual keyboard never pops up, so there is another dead end.  Then I had to restart my headset because there became no way to get rid of the browser or the surrounding windows to go back to the app.

You have the option to upgrade with different tiers and paid subscriptions, but honestly the free version gives me no incentive to upgrade at all.

I really think this is abandonware.  They got so far with it and quit optimizing it to where it can be intuitive or easy to use.  

Finally, you can create a character manually, but the features are lackluster.  Even Horizon Worlds has better/more adjustable features than this.
